LTX2.3 视听驱动数字人工作流程用户手册

1.线上工作流程使用LTX-2.3-22b-dev-fp8型号，本地版本可根据您的硬件配置进行调整。已确认 Q4.gguf 型号与 12GB VRAM 完全兼容。

2. 调整时请注意模型旁边的注释，确保节点连接正确。

3. KJ的模型提供了最佳的性价比，平衡了低硬件要求、快速生成速度和高输出质量。 GGUF版本配置要求最低，LTX-2.3-22b-dev-fp8版本视觉效果最佳。

4、决议选择适用具体规则；有关详细信息，请参阅分辨率设置旁边的注释。强烈建议使用横向模式——生成时支持纵向模式，但会产生较差的结果。

5. 测试条件：在具有 RTX 5060 Ti 16G + 32G RAM 的测试 PC 上以 1280×736 分辨率生成 10 秒的图像到视频。

- ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_scaled：335s

- ltx-2.3-22b-dev：20分钟

- LTX-2.3-22b-dev-fp8：500秒

- LTX-2.3-22b-dev-Q4_K_M.gguf：430秒

- LTX-2.3-22b-dev-Q8_0.gguf：470秒

6.自动生成的提示经过反复测试，也可以与提示模板一起使用，在其他AI代理中生成视频提示。

7、音频驱动生成，结束时间以音频文件上传后的视频时长为准。

8、自动生成的提示对音频驱动的生成效果影响很小；您可以断开自动提示链接并手动填写自定义提示。

分辨率选择指南

（1）LTX输出视频尺寸必须是32的倍数，严格的16:9宽高比，参考以下分辨率：512×288； 1024×576。

（2）其他近似16:9分辨率：1920×1088。

（3）输入分辨率为1280×720/736时，输出的视频分辨率均为1280×704。

（4）1280×768是完全支持正常输出的分辨率。

（5）更高的分辨率带来更好的视觉效果，但需要更强大的硬件配置。

工作流程中提供了模型下载链接。

此工作流程可用于免费在线测试 - 仅当您对结果满意时才下载它以供本地使用。

测试网址：https://www.runninghub.ai/post/2027025326320128001/?inviteCode=rh-v1443

奖励积分：新注册1000积分，每日登录100积分。上述测试参数单代仅消耗80点。

User Manual for LTX2.3 Audio-Visual Driven Digital Human Workflow

1. The online workflow uses the LTX-2.3-22b-dev-fp8 model, and the local version can be adjusted according to your hardware configuration. It is confirmed that the Q4.gguf model is fully compatible with 12GB VRAM.

2. Pay attention to the notes next to the model when making adjustments and ensure correct node connections.

3. KJ's model offers the best cost-performance ratio for balancing low hardware requirements, fast generation speed and high output quality. The GGUF version has the lowest configuration demands, while the LTX-2.3-22b-dev-fp8 model delivers the best visual effects.

4. Specific rules apply to resolution selection; see the notes next to the resolution settings for details. Landscape mode is highly recommended—portrait mode is supported for generation but will produce subpar results.

5. Test conditions: Generating a 10-second image-to-video at 1280×736 resolution on a test PC with RTX 5060 Ti 16G + 32G RAM.

- ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_scaled: 335s

- ltx-2.3-22b-dev: 20min

- LTX-2.3-22b-dev-fp8: 500s

- LTX-2.3-22b-dev-Q4_K_M.gguf: 430s

- LTX-2.3-22b-dev-Q8_0.gguf: 470s

6. The auto-generated prompts have been repeatedly tested and can also be used with prompt templates to generate video prompts in other AI agents.

7. For audio-driven generation, the end time shall be subject to the video duration after uploading the audio file.

8. Auto-generated prompts have little impact on the audio-driven generation effect; you can disconnect the auto-prompt link and fill in custom prompts manually.

Resolution Selection Guidelines

（1）The output video dimensions of LTX must be multiples of 32. For a strict 16:9 aspect ratio, refer to the following resolutions: 512×288; 1024×576.

（2）Other approximate 16:9 resolutions: 1920×1088.

（3）Input resolutions of 1280×720/736 will both output a video of 1280×704.

（4）1280×768 is a fully supported resolution for normal output.

（5）Higher resolutions yield better visual effects but require more powerful hardware configurations.

Model download links are provided in the workflow.

This workflow is available for free online testing—download it for local use only if you are satisfied with the results.

Test URL:https://www.runninghub.ai/post/2027025326320128001/?inviteCode=rh-v1443

Bonus Points: 1000 points for new registrations, 100 points for daily login. A single generation with the above test parameters consumes only 80 points.
